mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_dedup (fingerprint, alert_name, severity, source, hit_count, last_session_id, first_seen, last_seen) VALUES (#{alertDedup.fingerprint}, #{alertDedup.alertName}, #{alertDedup.severity}, #{alertDedup.source}, 1, #{alertDedup.lastSessionId}, now(), now()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hit_count = IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, last_seen, NOW()) >= #{windowMinutes}, 1, hit_count + 1), last_session_id = VALUES(last_session_id), last_seen = now()
